title: kb-sprint run starts workers as Sonnet headless sessions by default, the session model only on request
goal: Answers the SP-s5fdczv7 retrospective: kb-sprint run step 3 sends an S1 or S2 bug and a story with no tasks to a subagent on the session model, but the operator's budget preference is Sonnet headless claude -p sessions, which did that work in this sprint (an S2 investigation bug at 4.89 USD, an untasked story at 5.13 USD, all modelUsage sonnet). kb-sprint run step 3 makes a headless claude -p --model sonnet session the default worker for every item kind, keeps kb-worker.md as its role file, and takes the session model only when the operator asks for it; the review's fresh-context reviewer follows the same default; backlog.md says so.

run: import sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();ok='--model sonnet' in t and 'session model only' in t;print('sonnet headless default:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: Do tasks and subtasks also leave the kb-worker subagent for a headless claude -p --model sonnet session?
options: every kind headless Sonnet at high effort; kb-worker on the Agent tool only as the fallback
only S1/S2 bugs and stories with no tasks; tasks keep kb-worker
gates.recommendation: every kind headless Sonnet at high effort; kb-worker on the Agent tool only as the fallback
gates.answer: every kind headless Sonnet at high effort; kb-worker on the Agent tool only as the fallback
